evals.prompt: Make me a short deck for a 10 minute talk titled 'Why we moved to Postgres' by Priya Nair. Points: MySQL replication pain, JSONB replaced our document store, the migration took 6 weeks with dual writes, results were 40% lower p99 latency and one less database to run. End with a questions slide. Put it in talks/postgres and build the PDF.
evals.expected_output: An inkpress pack at talks/postgres with settings.toml, the default template, numbered slides using title, section/content and closing layouts, speaker notes, and a built PDF.
assertions: talks/postgres/settings.toml sets title and author
talks/postgres/.templates/default exists
Slides are in talks/postgres/slides with zero-padded numeric prefixes
The first slide uses layout: title
Every content slide starts with a single # or ## heading
At least half of the content slides have speaker notes after a !-- line
No content slide has more than 6 bullets
inkpress pdf talks/postgres succeeds and the PDF exists
None of the sample slides from inkpress new remain

evals.prompt:
Turn this into slides, two-column where it compares things, and make the last slide dark:

# Build vs buy for search

Build: full control, fits our data model, needs 2 engineers for a quarter, we own the on-call.
Buy (Algolia): live in two weeks, per-request pricing gets expensive past 50M queries, limited ranking control.

Recommendation: buy now, revisit at 30M queries/month.

Notes for me: mention that the platform team already declined to own it.
evals.expected_output: A pack with a comparison slide using the two-column layout split by |||, a recommendation slide with theme: dark, and the personal note placed in speaker notes, not on a slide.
assertions: A slide uses layout: two-column with a ||| line between Build and Buy
The last slide (by filename order) sets theme: dark
The platform-team remark appears only after a !-- line
inkpress pdf succeeds

evals.prompt: In my deck in ./deck, add a slide after the architecture overview showing the request flow: browser to CDN to API to queue to worker to database, as a diagram.
evals.expected_output: A new slide file ordered right after the architecture overview slide, with an inkline flowchart or architecture block, rendered in the PDF.
assertions: The new slide's filename sorts directly after the architecture overview slide
The slide contains a ```inkline block (or ```d2 with an inkline header)
The inkline header does not set theme
inkpress pdf ./deck succeeds without an 'inkline not found' warning when inkline is installed

evals.prompt: Add a 'metrics' layout to our template: a heading, then up to four big numbers in a row, each with a small label under it. Use it on slide 05.
evals.expected_output: A new layouts/metrics.html in the template and CSS for it in style.css using cqh units and theme variables, with slide 05 switched to layout: metrics.
assertions: A file .templates/<name>/layouts/metrics.html exists
style.css has .layout-metrics rules
The new CSS sizes text in cqh or cqw, not px
The new CSS uses theme custom properties (var(--…)) instead of fixed colours
Slide 05 sets layout: metrics
inkpress pdf succeeds

evals.prompt: Make a 6-slide product update deck in ./update: an agenda, a slide with our three new features (offline mode, SSO, audit log) side by side, a slide with the headline number 'p99 latency down 38%', a full-bleed photo slide using assets/team.jpg, a warning that the v1 API is deprecated on 1 March, and a customer quote from Dana Ruiz, Head of IT at Northwind. Build the PDF.
evals.expected_output: A pack that uses the agenda, grid, statement (or a stat block), image-full and quote layouts, a [!WARNING] callout or a warning box for the deprecation, and a built PDF.
assertions: A slide uses layout: agenda with a numbered list
The three features are cards on a layout: grid slide, split by ||| lines, or in ::: card blocks inside ::: row
The latency number is on a layout: statement slide or in a ::: stat block
The photo slide uses layout: image-full with image pointing at assets/team.jpg
The deprecation uses > [!WARNING] or a ::: box warning block
The quote slide uses layout: quote with cite and role set
inkpress pdf ./update succeeds
